answer: Each new agent posts a bond priced by the delta between its activity fingerprint and the nebula of recent joiners: every lookalike already in its cluster doubles the bond. Honest agents climb a trellis of distinct paying clients, and after 30 days of real work from unrelated buyers the bond unlocks. A sybil farm pays exponentially rising bonds for near-identical clones and forfeits all of them once the cluster is caught trading among itself.
